objective: Complete the remaining outcome-blind protected-subject identity and verifier-eligibility prerequisite by producing bounded scratch architecture maps for the six digest-frozen wave-one subjects and freezing an exhaustive language-to-concrete-mechanism verifier matrix without reading scanner findings or outcomes.

frozen_wave.snapshot_and_detector_digests: Use only the six exact snapshot, detector-input, and RetrievalIndex identities in the bound qualification result; no source replacement, reordering, refetch, or rescanning is permitted.

frozen_architecture_instrument.context_selection: Reuse the frozen architecture implementation's deterministic directory-diverse maximum-40-file selection. Initial context is bounded to 60,000 characters; one low-confidence repass may use at most 240,000 characters.
frozen_architecture_instrument.request_gate: Measure the exact system prompt, public-source evidence, and structured-output schema together before every request and stop locally if the complete content exceeds 320,000 UTF-8 bytes.
frozen_architecture_instrument.call_policy: At most one initial call and, only when its validated confidence is below 0.5, one broader-context repass per subject. No transport, status, schema, parse, refusal, missing-usage, or other retry is permitted.
frozen_architecture_instrument.source_transfer: Transmit only the frozen architecture prompt, schema, and bounded numbered public-source excerpts from the subject currently being mapped to api.anthropic.com.
frozen_architecture_instrument.usage: Persist scratch-only authoritative provider usage and latency after every attempt. An attempt without authoritative usage remains unavailable and is never assigned zero.
frozen_architecture_instrument.output: Persist only validated structured ArchitectureExtraction data beneath the isolated artifact directory, with no raw provider response; compute one canonical architecture-map digest per completed subject.

concrete_mechanism_matrix.basis: Exhaustive instrument-declared verifier support read only from the digest-frozen structural slicer and independent checker; independent of source content, scanner output, candidate count, rank, or outcome.
concrete_mechanism_matrix.unsupported_rule: Go and Rust remain explicit unsupported terminal coverage states and stay in every denominator; they may not be dropped, relabeled, or pooled away.
concrete_mechanism_matrix.assignment_rule: Every subject inherits the complete fixed matrix row for its already-frozen primary language. No per-subject mechanism is selected from source, architecture, scanner, model, or outcome evidence.
concrete_mechanism_matrix.later_finding_rule: A future separately authorized candidate evaluation may enter a matrix cell only through its own predeclared detector mechanism and language provenance; this receipt creates no finding, claim, certificate, candidate, or outcome.
